explained.summary: Socrates called the opinions of the crowd bogeymen, the sort of monsters used to scare children. Popular opinion can feel frightening, but much of its power to alarm us is no more real than a nursery threat. Marcus jots this down as a reminder not to be cowed by what most people think.
